name: Ethiopian Freshman Courses (Psyc 1011, FLEn 1011, FLEn 1012 & Phys 1011)
description: Bilingual (English & Amharic) learning platform and analytics dashboard for Ethiopian University Freshman courses across official MoE PDF modules including Mathematics for Social Sciences (Math 1011), General Biology (Biol 1012), Physical Fitness (SpSc 1011), Economics (Econ 1011), Moral and Citizenship Education (MCED 1011), Global Affairs (GLAF 1012 / GlTr 1012), Emerging Technologies (EmTe 1012), Inclusiveness (SNIE 1012), Logic & Critical Thinking (Phil 1011), Geography (GeES 1011), General Physics (Phys 1011), Social Anthropology (Anth 1012), Entrepreneurship (Mgmt 1012), General Psychology (Psyc 1011), and History of Ethiopia and the Horn (Hist 1012), with all titles, inside chapter subtitles, bilingual texts, summaries, and Q&A.
